rows.claim: The roster is a plain immutable value
rows.note: plane.roster is a mutable Vector in a mutable DataPlane. attach!/detach! push!/deleteat! it and _install_writers! replaces entries in place (src/roster.jl:451). The run copies it once (src/sim.jl:1645). D-087 states the immutable-value wording, but nothing records the mutable holder as a deviation from it beyond the DataPlane docstring.
rows.fix: The roster (roster entries, claims, attachment order) is fixed for the run. It changes only at stopped-sim `attach!`/`detach!`. The loop copies it once at `run!`, and nothing republishes it.
